title: Project: Customer Support Conversational AI (ShopEase)
content: Project Name: Customer Support Conversational AI (ShopEase) (Slug: customer-support-ai). Domain: Conversational AI / RAG. Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, React, NLP, RAG, Transformers, Vector DB, PyMuPDF. Key Evaluation & Accuracy: 88.72% Banking77 Test Accuracy, 88.76% Macro F1 across 77 intent classes. Architecture: User Query -> Prompt Guardrail & PII Masking -> Banking77 Intent Classifier -> 102-Chunk Vector Policy Retrieval -> Confidence Scoring -> Grounded Response or Human Escalation. GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Nagendrakushwaha/customer_support_AI. Live Demo: https://customer-support-ai-6.onrender.com/. Technical Highlights: 13,080 customer queries categorized across 77 fine-grained classes. Grounded RAG retrieval across 14 enterprise policy documents (102 chunks). Sub-180ms retrieval latency with zero-hallucination guardrails.

title: Project: Speech English Emotion Detection
content: Project Name: Speech English Emotion Detection (Slug: speech-english-emotion-detection). Domain: Acoustic Deep Learning. Tech Stack: Python, PyTorch, Librosa, 2D-CNN, SenseVoiceSmall, FastAPI, NumPy. Key Evaluation & Accuracy: 0.80 Macro AUC on CREMA-D held-out test speakers. Architecture: Raw Speech Waveform -> Silence Trimming -> STFT Windowing -> 64-Band Log-Mel Spectrogram -> PyTorch 2D-CNN Backbone -> Emotion Probability Distribution. GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Nagendrakushwaha/speech_english_emotion_detection. Technical Highlights: Trained on 7,442 professional vocal recordings from CREMA-D corpus. Classifies 6 emotions (Neutral, Happy, Sad, Angry, Fearful, Disgust) with strict speaker-independent cross-validation.

title: Project: Real-Time Credit Card Fraud Detection
content: Project Name: Real-Time Credit Card Fraud Detection (Slug: credit-card-fraud-detection). Domain: Machine Learning / Anomaly Detection. Tech Stack: LightGBM, Isolation Forests, SMOTE, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, Python. Key Evaluation & Accuracy: 86% Accuracy, 85% Precision, 86% Recall, 0.83 F1-Score. Architecture: Transaction Stream -> Isolation Forest Anomaly Filter -> SMOTE Resampled Classifier -> Calibrated Decision Thresholding. GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Nagendrakushwaha/credit_card_fraud_detection. Technical Highlights: Addresses severe class imbalance (<0.2% fraud transactions) using precision-recall optimization to minimize costly false negatives for financial institutions.
